title: AQCA: All Quantum Computing Algorithms
association: Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT), DU, DRDO
description: AQCA (All Quantum Computing Algorithms) is a state-of-the-art academic educational atlas and interactive simulation platform mapping 19 foundational and advanced quantum algorithms, communication protocols, phase/amplitude models, and fault-tolerant stabilizer codes. Features Dirac bra-ket mathematical proofs, interactive visualisers, Chart.js complexity benchmarks, and verified dual-track Qiskit/NumPy implementations.
features: 19 Complete Algorithm Profiles: Comprehensive documentation across 5 core pillars spanning quantum communication, oracle query models, phase/amplitude manipulation, hybrid NISQ variational models, and fault-tolerant stabilizer codes.

Interactive Visualisers & Complexity Benchmarking: Web-based simulation interfaces for stepping through quantum circuits, inspecting phase kickback, and Chart.js dynamic scaling curves (classical vs. quantum).
Deep Mathematical Rigor & Dirac Notation: Complete state vector evolutions in Dirac bra-ket notation (|ψ⟩, ⟨ψ|), operator matrices, and computational complexity bounds rendered with MathJax v3.
Single Source of Truth (AQAC.ipynb): Master Jupyter Notebook containing tested pure NumPy and Qiskit code implementations, circuit schematics, and measurement output plots.
